Title: The Roaring Road
Summary: A young man pursues a young lady with the same energy he applies to his other obsession in life, auto racing.
Directed by: James Cruze
Actors: Wallace Reid, Ann Little, Theodore Roberts
Production Company: Paramount Pictures
Release Date: 27 April 1919 (USA)
Aspect Ratio: 1.33 : 1
   A young man pursues a young lady with the same energy he applies to his other obsession in life, auto racing.
